name: @xpert-ai/plugin-sites
description: Sites app plugin for creating, saving, deploying, and inspecting hosted sites from data-xpert Assistants.
author: XpertAI

interface.shortDescription: Create, review, and publish websites with an Agent

icon.value: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 32 32" width="256" height="256" fill="none" stroke="#4F46E5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" role="img" aria-label="Sites"><path d="M26 18v9H4V5h13M4 11h13"/><path d="M9 8h.01M13 8h.01"/><path d="M20 4h9v9M29 4 17 16" stroke="#8185DC"/><path d="M9 18h4M9 23h11"/></svg>

description.en_US: Build, preview and publish static sites from your Assistant.
description.zh_Hans: 通过助手创建、预览和发布静态站点。

tagline.en_US: An idea becomes a working site.
tagline.zh_Hans: 让想法成为可以打开的站点。

description.en_US: Build HTML, CSS and JavaScript in the sandbox, with local modules, images and fonts.
description.zh_Hans: 在沙箱编写 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript，支持本地模块、图片与字体。

description.en_US: Save immutable candidates and redeploy a previous version.
description.zh_Hans: 保存不可变的候选版本，也可以重新发布历史版本。

description.en_US: Publish an isolated artifact with private, workspace or confirmed public access.
description.zh_Hans: 发布隔离的站点产物，可设为私有、工作空间可见，或确认后公开。

dataScope.en_US: Projects are private to each user and Assistant. Published HTML runs in an isolated browser sandbox without network API access.
dataScope.zh_Hans: 项目按用户和助手隔离。发布的 HTML 在隔离浏览器沙箱运行，不能访问网络 API。

initializationSummary.en_US: Creates a workspace and Sites Assistant. Uses your selected model and the host sandbox. Server-side storage and authentication require a separate hosting adapter.
initializationSummary.zh_Hans: 创建工作空间和站点助手，使用选择的模型及平台沙箱。服务端存储和认证需要独立托管适配器。
